choice_data_list: Are you not getting enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list: Are you not getting enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, hush, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's just that yesterday, I got totally 
carried away having girl talk with my 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She was running close to curfew, so I gave 
her a ride in my beloved Tac-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, yesterday was yesterday, and today 
is today. No problem at all!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her words, Maruzensky still looked 
sleepy.
